instruction: Use command-line automation only to operate the installed SOLIDWORKS CAM 2025 environment through the CAMWorks API; do not use GUI clicks, GUI automation, generic G-code generators, prebuilt helper wrappers, or manual .nc editing/copying. Load C:\Users\User\Desktop\p1.step, C:\Users\User\Desktop\p2.step, C:\Users\User\Desktop\p3.step, and read C:\Users\User\Desktop\tools.csv. Create three independent native CAM parts, one from each STEP input; do not copy or reuse a CAM document, setup, operation, or NC program between parts. For each part, create one outside Profile/Contour operation about its complete rectangular perimeter. Use G54 with the part's own top-face center at model coordinates [0, 0, 10] mm and tool axis -Z, so posted top is Z=0 and the 10 mm bottom is Z=-10. Use T1, a 6 mm flat end mill, at S9000 rpm and F650 mm/min for material-cutting XY contour moves; controlled plunge feed may be lower. Apply one correct cutter-radius compensation method: either CAM-computed 3 mm outside tool-center offset with controller compensation off, or a nominal-boundary path with correct controller compensation. Generate a complete closed outside contour with safe approach and retract, then post-process each native CAM part with the installed SOLIDWORKS CAM postprocessor. Save the posted NC outputs exactly as C:\Users\User\Desktop\p1.nc, C:\Users\User\Desktop\p2.nc, and C:\Users\User\Desktop\p3.nc.
source: Installed SOLIDWORKS CAM 2025 / CAMWorks API; official SOLIDWORKS CAM product and training documentation: https://www.solidworks.com/product/solidworks-cam ; https://www.solidworks.com/support/training/solidworks-cam-standard
